title: Italian Stuffed Peppers + Mashed Potatoes | 45g Protein
description: These Italian stuffed peppers combine lean beef and ground chicken with tomato basil sauce and mozzarella, plus creamy Greek-yogurt mashed potatoes for approximately 45 grams of protein and 380 calories.
image_prompt: A realistic comfort-food dinner on a warm neutral stoneware plate. Show exactly two stuffed bell pepper halves per serving: one red half and one green half. Each pepper is generously filled with a saucy ground beef-and-chicken Italian tomato filling and topped with melted lightly browned mozzarella. Beside the peppers is a creamy scoop of mashed gold potatoes with subtle black pepper and a light herb garnish. The peppers should look roasted and tender but still hold their shape. No rice, breadcrumbs, corn, beans, or other unlisted ingredients. Warm natural light and cozy home-cooked appearance.
image_alt_text: Italian stuffed red and green peppers with melted mozzarella and creamy protein mashed potatoes.
